description: Corrected-coordinate ProteomicsDB peptide analysis: test directly whether any public peptide ends at Q432 and establish MS accessibility of the region
code:
import requests, json, os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seq="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q9H9K5.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:]); N=len(seq)
url="https://www.proteomicsdb.org/proteomicsdb/logic/api/proteinpeptideresult.xsodata/InputParams(PROTEINFILTER='Q9H9K5')/Results"
rows=requests.get(url, params={'$format':'json'}, timeout=90).json()['d']['results']
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); df['START_POSITION']=df.START_POSITION.astype(int); df['END_POSITION']=df.END_POSITION.astype(int)

# --- coordinate convention check: ProteomicsDB START is 0-based exclusive; true start = START+1
df['start1']=df.START_POSITION+1; df['end1']=df.END_POSITION
ok=sum(seq[r.start1-1:r.end1]==r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE for _,r in df.iterrows())
print(f"coordinate convention validated: {ok}/{len(df)} records map exactly with start1 = START_POSITION+1")

pep=(df.groupby(['PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE','start1','end1'])
       .agg(n_records=('ID','size'), n_projects=('PROJECT_NAME','nunique'),
            projects=('PROJECT_NAME', lambda s: "; ".join(sorted(set(s)))),
            pmids=('PUBMEDID', lambda s: ",".join(sorted({str(x).strip() for x in s if str(x).strip()}))),
            best_q=('PEPTIDE_Q_VALUE', lambda s: float(np.min(pd.to_numeric(s))))).reset_index().sort_values('start1'))
print(f"\nUnique peptides: {len(pep)}")
print(pep[['PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE','start1','end1','n_records','n_projects','best_q','pmids']].to_string(index=False))

cov=np.zeros(N+2,dtype=int)
for _,r in pep.iterrows(): cov[r.start1:r.end1+1]+=1
covered=int((cov[1:N+1]>0).sum())
print(f"\nCoverage: {covered}/{N} = {covered/N:.1%}")

ends=set(pep.end1); starts=set(pep.start1)
print("\n================ DIAGNOSTIC QUESTIONS ================")
print(f"Peptide ending exactly at Q432 (shed neo-C-terminus)?      {'YES' if 432 in ends else 'NO'}")
print(f"Peptide starting exactly at R433 (stub neo-N-term, major)? {'YES' if 433 in starts else 'NO'}")
print(f"Peptide ending exactly at R433 (minor-site neo-C-term)?    {'YES' if 433 in ends else 'YES but fully tryptic -> uninformative'}")
print(f"Residue 432 covered by any peptide?                        {'YES' if cov[432]>0 else 'NO'}  (depth {cov[432]})")
print(f"Peptide spanning the intact Q432-R433 bond?                {[ (r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE,r.start1,r.end1) for _,r in pep.iterrows() if r.start1<=432 and r.end1>=433 ]}")
print(f"Next peptide C-terminal to the site:                       {[ (r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE,r.start1,r.end1) for _,r in pep.iterrows() if r.start1==434 ]}")

tp=[(s,e) for s,e in [(i+1,j) for i,j in zip([0]+[k+1 for k,c in enumerate(seq) if c in 'KR'],[k+1 for k,c in enumerate(seq) if c in 'KR']+[N])] if s<=432<=e][0]
print(f"\nFully tryptic peptide spanning 432: {tp[0]}-{tp[1]} = {seq[tp[0]-1:tp[1]]}")
print(f"Observed as KDHVLDIPTTQR (422-433): {'YES' if ('KDHVLDIPTTQR',422,433) in set(zip(pep.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE,pep.start1,pep.end1)) else 'NO'}")
print("Shed-form diagnostic semi-tryptic peptide 423-432 = DHVLDIPTTQ (1123.58 Da monoisotopic [M]), differs from tryptic 422-433 by K+R")
print("\nCRITICAL CAVEAT: all 17 peptides are fully tryptic. A fully-tryptic search space CANNOT report a peptide")
print("ending at Q432. The absence is therefore a search-space limitation, NOT biological evidence against the site.")
print("What IS informative: the region is MS-accessible (KDHVLDIPTTQR observed in 2 records), so a targeted")
print("semi-tryptic reanalysis of these same raw files would be decisive.")

pep.to_csv(os.path.join(os.getcwd(),"ERVMER34-1_proteomicsdb_peptides.csv"), index=False)

fig,(ax,ax2)=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),gridspec_kw={'height_ratios':[2,1]})
ax.fill_between(np.arange(1,N+1), cov[1:N+1], step='mid', color='#4299e1', alpha=.8, label='ProteomicsDB distinct peptides')
ax.axvspan(489,509,color='#fc8181',alpha=.5,label='TM 489-509')
ax.axvspan(27,432,color='#bee3f8',alpha=.35,label='shed form 27-432')
ax.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2.2); ax.text(432.5,cov.max()*1.15,'Q432/R433',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('n distinct peptides'); ax.set_xlim(1,N); ax.set_ylim(0,max(2,cov.max()*1.3))
ax.set_title(f'ProteomicsDB evidence for Q9H9K5 (protein 81327): 17 peptides, {covered/N:.0%} coverage, all fully tryptic')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper left')
ax2.set_xlim(415,450); ax2.set_ylim(0,3.2); ax2.set_yticks([])
for i,(s,e,p) in enumerate([(r.start1,r.end1,r.PEPTIDE_SEQUENCE) for _,r in pep.iterrows() if r.end1>=415 and r.start1<=450]):
    ax2.barh(1+i*0.8, e-s+1, left=s, height=0.45, color='#2b6cb0')
    ax2.text((s+e)/2, 1+i*0.8, f"{p} ({s}-{e})", ha='center', va='center', color='w', fontsize=8)
ax2.barh(0.3, 10, left=423, height=0.45, color='#e53e3e', alpha=.85)
ax2.text(428, 0.3, 'DHVLDIPTTQ (423-432) NOT OBSERVED\nsemi-tryptic, outside the search space', ha='center', va='center', color='w', fontsize=7.5)
ax2.axvline(432.5,color='k',lw=2.2)
ax2.set_xlabel('residue'); ax2.set_title('Zoom on the shedding site: the observed peptide spans the intact bond; the shed neo-C-terminus is absent')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
